body:
I had some 5-MeO-DMT lingering in my fridge for almost 3/4 of a year. I ordered 150mgs and had the occasional toke of the stuff blanketed in pot since it was HCL and not freebase. This method works, but is kind of unpredictable since the burning temperatures of marijuana and 5-meo HCL vary widely and 5-meo is best vaporized as a freebase over indirect heat (ie. Using a crack pipe), it was easy to underdose, so I always added a hefty amount of the salts, ar least 20mgs, easily 10x what is needed when freebasing the compound. It was tricky to smoke and kind of scary so I just left it for a long time until a friend gave me some  Changa, a crude Acacia extraction which lends itself to open flame smoking over the more sensitive N,N-DMT.
Damned if it isn't capable of some very profound shit, Dimethyl-esqe trips. This resin I also protected with some Pot over top and slow smoking, it also worked over a carrier (ash) and I'm not sure the protective layer of Cannabis was necessary. I protected it anyway, lighting one side of the bowl and sort of dragging the cherry across the "hot zone", a distinctly flowery and somewhat raspy smoke.
The first time I hit this
was Christmas of 2019, and was immediately enamored with DMT-like substances. I'd heard Changa could be unpleasant since it is a total extract of the Acacia source, including all the plant crap one may not wish to ingest like tannins. I found there was very little body load and there was almost no side effects at all save shock and awe. After the first hit
went as smooth as silk (similar in come up and color scheme to--but distinctly different from DMT), I decided this was going to be a multi-day session and what's more, it was time to break out the 5-meo again and give it a proper day in court. By itself 5-meo was kind of overwhelming, but when balancing the God molecule with the Spirit molecule seemed to make the 5-MeO much more bearable. It seemed Changa was a nice primer for 5-meo, they seemed to be odd reflections of one another with Changa being very visual and colorful in presentation with a certain gentle warmth behind its cold entry, one being wholly introspective but definitely similar in method of enlightenment. Changa was lighter than 5-meo, but the Dimethyltryptamine family kind of all act similarly, if not exactly the same. Even method of ingestion creates wide variables even within the same molecular designation (ie. DMT in Ayahuasca as opposed to vaporized DMT, very different experiences by miles).
I took a 4 day sojourn into the DMT space, the longest I've ever spent with an entheogen aside from Ketamine
I took a 4 day sojourn into the DMT space, the longest I've ever spent with an entheogen aside from Ketamine
, a compound I devote similar blocks of time to. Though Ketamine is a bit less frantic--and dare I say, more consciousness expanding than DMT. Owing likely to K's gentler on set, longer duration, more thorough visual disconnection and Ketamine's notable anti-depressant effects, though a similar level of profundity exists in both short-acting psychedelics, though of course DMT is far safer, with no reported injuries I am aware of, while Ketamine is mentioned in an article called "Known unknowns", which deals with the mysterious neurological impairments NMDA-antagonists like Ketamine can cause.
If someone were to make a habit out of either trip, DMT or Changa would be a much safer way to fly, just not the "sinking-into-a-warm-bath" entry of Ketamine, which is also notably addictive. I have never used enough Ketamine to develop a habit, but be damned if I don't miss it like a lover when it's gone. DMT/Changa is usually easy enough to put aside when I've gotten my fill.
[Reported Dose: Changa -- 1 gram over 4 days; 5-MeO -- 100mgs over 4 days]
